body: Product found concrete timing evidence for TASK-3143. The mandate renewal audit at Nov 21 19:07:47 MST extended grant 041cbfae's record from Nov 21 19:32:18 MST to Nov 22 17:59:44 MST. The latest accepted job carrying 041cbfae (01a20118-7b26...) was issued at 19:31:51 MST, about 28 seconds before the old expiry. Product's grant bda9fde0 also had its record extended from 19:38:56 MST to Nov 22 17:59:44 MST. It validated earlier and now fails aida role status with the same missing session-key diagnostic. Source confirms renewal can only extend a key in the renewing process's own keyring. This strongly points to original key expiry in existing Codex sessions rather than an expired mandate. The documented recovery is to relaunch the advisor from an authorized terminal with a fresh session key, then verify aida role status and one read-only deputy job from the actual new Codex tool context. Keep the live mandate. Operator-owned submissions are an available separate path while the seat is recovered.
subject: Deputy refusal aligns with original session-key expiry
